title: Task-Calibrated Random Features via Influence-Based Error Cancellation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random features approximate kernel integrals by Monte Carlo, yet only selected frequency-sampling errors affect a downstream task. We propose Task-Calibrated Random Features (TCRF), which balance frequency moments constructed from task-specific influence using weights shared across kernel entries. Closed-form weights coincide with classical minimum-distance calibration; the contribution is a reusable, task-derived calibration space. We show that first-order variance equals the residual variance after projection onto this space. For kernel ridge regression, complete cancellation yields a non-Gaussian second-order limit. For kernel Stein discrepancy, a subset identity and disjoint-block variance decomposition eliminate the linear component of pilot noise. translated_title: 基于影响性误差消除的任务校准随机特征
translated_abstract: 随机特征通过蒙特卡洛方法近似核积分，然而只有特定的频率采样误差会影响下游任务。我们提出了任务校准随机特征（TCRF），它利用在核条目之间共享的权重，来平衡由任务特定影响构建的频率矩。闭式解权重与经典的最小距离校准方法相一致；其贡献在于提供了一个可重用的、由任务导出的校准空间。我们证明了第一阶方差等于投影到该空间后的残差方差。对于核岭回归，完全消除会产生非高斯的二阶极限。对于核Stein差异，子集恒等式和不交块方差分解消除了试点噪声的线性分量。正的指数倾斜权重保持了半正定的特征表示，并支持更高的可行校准秩。配对实验显示了改进的近似
tldr: 该论文提出任务校准随机特征（TCRF），通过基于任务特定影响构建的可重用校准空间来平衡频率矩并消除对下游任务有影响的采样误差，从而改进核岭回归和核Stein差异等核方法的近似质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Task-Calibrated Random Features (TCRF), which balance frequency moments using a reusable, task-derived calibration space based on task-specific influence to cancel sampling errors affecting downstream tasks, improving kernel approximation quality for kernel ridge regression and kernel Stein discrepancy.
